# netactuate_cloud_location_vlans (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Location Vlans visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_location_vlans" "example" {
  location_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_id` (Number) Cloud location ID whose customer VLANs should be listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vlans` (List of Object) Customer VLANs at the requested cloud location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans))

<a id="nestedatt--vlans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans`

Read-Only:

- `allow_sriov` (Number)
- `created` (String)
- `customer_vlan_id` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mbid` (Number)
- `private` (Number)
- `provisioned_locations` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--vlans--provisioned_locations))

<a id="nestedobjatt--vlans--provisioned_locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans.provisioned_locations`

Read-Only:

- `flag` (String)
- `iata_code` (String)
- `location_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `provisioned` (Boolean)
